Name: ZH's EBAGI - SVE Forage Crops
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/E7t8a8g.png[/img]﻿[/center]
ZH's EBAGI mod series was made to be paired up with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods[/url] mod, adding EBAGI icons for all available artisan goods, which currently includes: Dried Mushrooms, Honey, Jelly, Juice, Pickles and Wine.[center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RLMQOV9.png[/img]﻿[/center][left]﻿
There are three different mod files, only pick the ones that you need.

[b][u]ZH's EBAGI - SVE Forage[/u][/b]
 This contains both Honey and Dried Mushrooms. So if you enabled both the [b]Rafflesia Category Change[/b] and [b]Edible Green Mushroom[/b] and [b]Edible Monster Mushrooms[/b] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]SVE Forage Crops[/url]﻿, then download and install this file. 

[u][b]ZH's EBAGI - SVE Forage Honey[/b][/u]
 This contains only Honey files, so if you enabled the [b]Rafflesia Category Change[/b] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]SVE Forage Crops[/url]﻿ but not [b]Edible Green Mushroom[/b] and [b]Edible Monster Mushrooms[/b], then download and install this file.
 [/left][b][u]ZH's EBAGI - SVE Forage Mushrooms[/u][/b]
 This contains only Dried Mushroom files, so if you enabled the [b]Edible Green Mushroom[/b] and [b]Edible Monster Mushrooms[/b] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]SVE Forage Crops[/url]﻿ but not [b]Rafflesia Category Change[/b], then download and install this file.

If you didn't enable any of these options, then don't download this mod.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/GqSTJrq.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Until I figure out an easier way to change the styles around, this is currently how to change the styles. If a more experienced modder knows how I can do this, please feel free to let me know it would be a big help!

1. Inside the mod folder, there is both an Assets and All_Assets folder.

[left]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/9JLbgZd.png[/img]﻿
[b]Assets[/b] is what will[i] [/i][u][i]appear in game[/i]
[/u][b]All_Assets[/b] has all available options to choose from.[/left]
2. You need to replace the .png files in [b]Assets [/b]folder with the ones that you want. Go through the [b]All_Assets[/b] folder to find the pattern and colour you want to use.

[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mXuCG7e.png[/img]﻿[/center]
3. [b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/b] Make sure that the .png files you replace in the Assets folder have the correct file name. If you change the names in any way, then it will not work. The correct names are shown in the image above this point.

There is a full image guide inside the mod folder that shows a visual guide on how to change your style. Please refer to that if needed.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pcnCZXd.png[/img]﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url].
3. Download the .zip file from this mod and install it

You're all done and ready to play.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pi5xeT0.png[/img]﻿﻿
